description: Calculate the recommended wire gauge / cable cross-section for a DC circuit. Considers both ampacity (current carrying capacity) and voltage drop to recommend the optimal cable size. Also returns total resistance, power loss, and a fuse recommendation. Supports copper conductors from 0.75 mm² (18 AWG) to 240 mm² (300 MCM).

current.description: Load current in amps. Provide either current or power.

isRoundTrip.description: Account for both positive and negative conductor (default: true). Set to false for chassis-ground returns.

maxVoltageDropPercent.description: Maximum acceptable voltage drop in percent (default: 3%)

power.description: Load power in watts. Will be converted to current using the voltage. Provide either current or power.

temperatureCelsius.description: Ambient temperature in °C (default: 20°C). Affects copper resistance.

name: calculate_wire_gauge
title: Cable Cross-Section & Resistance Calculator
